newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Readymix says Q1 profit up, sees good year.
newsitem.headline: Readymix says Q1 profit up, sees good year.

text.p: Irish-based building products group Readymix Plc said on Wednesday that first-quarter profits were higher than the year-earlier quarter and that it was on track for another very good year.

"Trading in 1997 got off to an excellent start in the first quarter of the year, exceeding our expectations and producing profits which were ahead of the first quarter of 1996," chairman Martin Rafferty said at the group's annual general meeting.
"The high level of demand in April and May is also well ahead of last year. This trend confirms economic and industry projects and puts the company on track for another very good year," he added.
Readymix reported an 85 percent rise in pre-tax profits to 8.71 million Irish pounds for the year ended December 31, 1996.
